fsid.description: Unique cluster ID (UUID) for the Ceph cluster. Required for new deployments.

mon_initial_members.description: Hostnames or IPs of the initial monitor nodes. Used to bootstrap the initial quorum.

mon_host.description: All monitor hostnames or IPs reachable by clients and other monitors. Should include *all* mons, not just initial ones.

public_network.description: CIDR subnet for client-facing network (e.g., 192.168.1.0/24). Optional but strongly recommended for multi-homed setups.

cluster_network.description: CIDR subnet for internal cluster communication (monitor-to-monitor, OSD heartbeats). Optional but recommended for performance isolation.

auth_cluster_required.description: Authentication protocol required for cluster daemons (mon-to-mon). Set to 'none' only for testing.

auth_service_required.description: Authentication protocol required for services (e.g., MDS, RBD).

log_file.description: Path and format for log files. Supports $name (service name) and $pid placeholders.

ms_bind_ipv4.description: Bind monitor’s messaging layer to IPv4 addresses.

ms_bind_ipv6.description: Bind monitor’s messaging layer to IPv6 addresses. Usually disabled unless IPv6-only.

mon_data.description: Local filesystem path where monitor data (WAL + DB) is stored. Use $id to substitute monitor ID.

mon_clock_drift_allowed.description: Maximum allowed clock drift (in seconds) between monitors before quorum warnings or failures occur. Tighter for production (e.g., 0.05–0.1).

mon_clock_drift_warn_backoff.description: Time (in seconds) to wait before re-checking clock drift after a warning.

mon_lease.description: Duration (in seconds) of the primary monitor lease. Longer values increase resilience to transient failures.

mon_lease_renew_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between lease renewal attempts by the primary monitor.

mon_lease_ack_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) to wait for acknowledgment of a lease request from the secondary monitors.

mon_osd_min_down_reporters.description: Minimum number of OSDs that must report an OSD as down before the monitor considers it down. Prevents false positives in large clusters.

mon_osd_reporter_subtree_level.description: CRUSH subtree level to consider when reporting OSD down. Common values: 'host', 'rack', 'root'.

mon_data_size_hint.description: Hints for monitor database size tuning (0 = auto). Only relevant for legacy filestore mons.

options.description: Key-value pairs of config options for this section.

additional_services.description: List of additional service sections to append. Useful for adding MDS, RGW, or custom per-daemon overrides.
